59652240.s: Radhwa Museum is one of the largest museums in Saudi Arabia. It began when Salem Al Hujouri, a lover of history, decided to turn his home into a museum, inheriting this precious hobby from his father. He first collected newspapers, books and postage stamps, but the hobby grew, and his desire widened to keep everything that reflects the history of the region and shows it as it deserves, until his hobby finally produced a tourist treasure.
59652240.b:
Radhwa Museum is one of the largest museums in Saudi Arabia. It began when Salem Al Hujouri, a lover of history, decided to turn his home into a museum, inheriting this precious hobby from his father. He first collected newspapers, books and postage stamps, but the hobby grew, and his desire widened to keep everything that reflects the history of the region and shows it as it deserves, until his hobby finally produced a tourist treasure.

As soon as you enter Radhwa Museum, you will not believe how many heritage items are gathered in one place, including coffee utensils, weapons and lanterns. The layout imitates old shops, and the museum is divided into six halls. The first hall displays textiles, clothing and taxidermy. The second is decorated with fine art and war pieces from the early Islamic eras, such as swords, rifles and shields embroidered with Arabic phrases. In the third hall you will find many rare Islamic and Arab coins. The fourth hall is devoted to manuscripts, newspapers and old books. The fifth hall shows a collection of cooking utensils made of copper and clay, and the sixth hall has tools once used for fishing and a collection of large stuffed fish that reflect the diversity of marine life in Yanbu.

59652182.s: The historic area of Yanbu is about 2,500 years old and has witnessed historic events, the most important being the events of Britain's war against the Ottomans and the Battle of Al Ushayrah, which began in the time of the Prophet (peace be upon him). Many important figures lived in the city of Yanbu, among them Lawrence of Arabia, Abdullah bin Al Hasan bin Al Hasan bin Ali bin Abi Talib and the Companion Abu Abdullah Harmala Al Mudliji (may God be pleased with him). Today the historic area of Yanbu has become a heritage museum that attracts many tourists from everywhere to see the long history of the city of Yanbu.

59480938.s: Bayt Al Jirmal (a corruption of the name "German House") is an archaeological building on the coast of Qumah Island, part of the Farasan Islands in the Jazan region in the south of Saudi Arabia. The story of the house is that the Germans built a large warehouse on Qumah Island to store the coal used as fuel by steamships passing through the Red Sea between the Suez Canal in the north-west of the Red Sea and Bab Al Mandab in the south-east.

59480886.t: Al Qassar Heritage Village in Farasan
59480886.s: Al Qassar Heritage Village, known for short as Al Qassar, is an old village on Farasan Island, part of the Jazan region in south-western Saudi Arabia. It also has inscriptions and drawings, some of which date to the Himyarite era.

59480833.t: House of Al Rifai in Farasan Island
59480833.s: The House of Al Rifai, or Al Rifai residence, is one of the archaeological sites on Farasan Island, part of the Jazan region in south-western Saudi Arabia, and was built in 1341 AH. It was built by the pearl merchant Ahmed Al Munawwar Al Rifai, who was one of the most important and largest merchants on the island in the past. The house is notable for the beauty of its design and carvings and is a true masterpiece of old architectural art, reflecting the wealth and luxury of Farasan in the days when the pearl trade flourished.
